facts.fact: CEGA says the Togo Data Lab, housed in the Ministry of Digital Economy and Transformation, plans as its first use case to institutionalise the MOSAIKS satellite-imagery machine-learning tool within the Ministry of Agriculture for predictive models.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Transformation with CEGA

TGO.note: Document states nothing on rules or an authority on AI harms.
Document names a data science lab and planned use cases, not an AI system in service or testing in administration.
The Ministry of Agriculture use case is only planned; nothing is piloted or built.
MOSAIKS is CEGA's tool; no AI model, dataset or computing is stated as built in Togo.
Document does not mention e-procurement.
Document does not mention the central bank.
Document describes training of lab data scientists, not a civil-service digital-skills programme.
Document does not mention consumer protection.
Document does not mention cross-border payments.
Document gives no rural programme or rural and urban figures.
Document describes no programme teaching digital skills to the public.
Strategy named only in passing; document states no adoption, text, period or reporting.
Novissi is mentioned for its targeting; the document does not say how payments were made.
Document gives no mobile ownership figure.
Document gives no account-ownership survey figure.
CEGA is a foreign institution; no Togo-based research institution is named.
Mobile money is mentioned only as a general gain, with no service details.
Document does not mention tax or fee payment.
Document does not mention schools.
Novissi is described by its targeting and 150,000 extra households, not by a management information system.
